description: Federation is a mutual claim and nothing else: two nodes federate when each lists the other's canonical well-known URL under the .../rel#peer relation, and tools/validate-wellknown --peer checks both directions offline from two local files. This is the only executable proof of the "smallest protocol" claim of AGSC-10-12, and the only vector citing a spec/10 rule.
note: path updated 2026-09-04 (D60) from /.well-known/agentic-knowledge to /.well-known/knowledge-linkset; this vector was added today at rc.2 and is unreleased, so editing in place is allowed (never done to disc-0001/0002, which are withdrawn and frozen).
